metrics.name: Net patient service revenue
metrics.definition: Expected net revenue (gross charges less expected contractual allowances) for accounts discharged in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(account.expected_net) WHERE discharge_date IN period

metrics.name: Gross charges
metrics.definition: Gross charges for accounts discharged in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(account.gross_charges) WHERE discharge_date IN period

metrics.name: Contractual adjustment rate
metrics.definition: Expected contractual allowance as a share of gross charges.
metrics.calculation: 1 − SUM(expected_net) / SUM(gross_charges), by discharge date

metrics.name: Contractual adjustments ($)
metrics.definition: All contractual adjustments: gross charges less expected net reimbursement, for accounts discharged in the period. Excludes charity, bad debt and denial write-offs.
metrics.calculation: SUM(gross_charges) − SUM(expected_net), by discharge date

metrics.name: Bad debt write-offs
metrics.definition: Patient balances transferred to bad debt in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(transaction.amount) WHERE type = BAD_DEBT AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: Bad debt % of NPSR
metrics.definition: Bad debt write-offs as a share of net patient service revenue in the same period.
metrics.calculation: Bad debt write-offs (post date) / NPSR (discharge date)

metrics.name: Charity care
metrics.definition: Patient balances adjusted under the financial assistance policy in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(transaction.amount) WHERE type = CHARITY AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: Charity care % of NPSR
metrics.definition: Charity care adjustments as a share of NPSR. No target: the level follows community need and policy.
metrics.calculation: Charity adjustments (post date) / NPSR (discharge date)

metrics.name: Cost to collect
metrics.definition: Revenue cycle operating cost as a share of cash collected.
metrics.calculation: SUM(gl.rcm_operating_cost) / Cash collections, same period

metrics.name: Net to gross ratio
metrics.definition: Net patient revenue as a percentage of gross patient revenue; reflects contractual adjustments and overall yield. No target: depends on facility and payer mix.
metrics.calculation: (Net Patient Revenue ÷ Gross Patient Revenue) × 100, by discharge date

metrics.name: Net days in credit balance
metrics.definition: Absolute patient-account credit-balance exposure expressed as days of average daily net patient service revenue. Prototype: credit balances are modeled, because the synthetic data has no overpayments.
metrics.calculation: Absolute(Month-End Credit Balance AR) ÷ (Trailing 90-day Net Patient Service Revenue ÷ 90)

metrics.name: Point-of-service cash % of net revenue
metrics.definition: Patient cash collected before service, at service, or within the defined POS window as a percentage of net revenue.
metrics.calculation: (Patient POS Payments ÷ Net Patient Service Revenue) × 100, by service date

metrics.name: Bad debt as % of gross revenue
metrics.definition: Bad debt provision recorded on the income statement as a percentage of gross patient service revenue. Prototype: the provision is the bad debt transfers posted in the period.
metrics.calculation: (Bad Debt Provision ÷ Gross Patient Service Revenue) × 100

metrics.name: Bad debt incl. unrealized as % of gross revenue
metrics.definition: Bad debt already recorded plus open account balances that meet the organization's bad-debt criteria but have not yet been written off, as a percentage of gross patient service revenue. Prototype criteria: self-pay balances open more than the configured days after discharge.
metrics.calculation: ((Bad Debt Provision + Unrealized Bad Debt at period end) ÷ Gross Patient Service Revenue) × 100

metrics.name: Avoidable write-offs as % of net revenue
metrics.definition: Realized avoidable write-offs as a percentage of average monthly net patient service revenue. Prototype: avoidable write-offs are write-offs after a final denial, net of recoveries.
metrics.calculation: (Net Avoidable Write-Offs ÷ Average Monthly Net Patient Service Revenue) × 100

metrics.name: Avoidable write-offs incl. unrealized as % of net revenue
metrics.definition: Realized avoidable write-offs plus unrealized avoidable write-offs, as a percentage of net patient service revenue. Prototype definition of unrealized: expected net on open, unresolved denials older than the configured days.
metrics.calculation: ((Net Avoidable Write-Offs + Defined Unrealized Avoidable Write-Offs at period end) ÷ Average Monthly Net Patient Service Revenue) × 100

metrics.name: Cash collections
metrics.definition: Payer and patient payments posted in the period, including point-of-service cash. Target = cash goal (goal % × lagged NPSR).
metrics.calculation: SUM(transaction.amount) WHERE type = PAYMENT AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: Cash goal
metrics.definition: Expected cash for the period: the cash-to-NPSR goal × lagged average daily NPSR (period shifted back 1, 2 and 3 months) × days in the period.
metrics.calculation: cash_goal_pct × lagged average daily NPSR × days in period

metrics.name: Cash as % of net revenue
metrics.definition: Total patient service cash collected in the reporting period as a percentage of average monthly net patient service revenue for the most recent 3 months (including the reporting month). Multi-month periods compare against the monthly average times the months in the period.
metrics.calculation: (Total Patient Service Cash Collected ÷ Average Monthly Net Patient Service Revenue for the Most Recent 3 Months) × 100

metrics.name: Net collection rate
metrics.definition: Payments received to date on accounts discharged 7–9 months before period end, as a share of their expected net revenue (mature cohort).
metrics.calculation: SUM(payments to date) / SUM(expected_net) WHERE discharge_date IN (period end −9 to −7 months)

metrics.name: Payment variance
metrics.definition: Insurance payments posted minus expected reimbursement on the same accounts. Negative = underpaid.
metrics.calculation: SUM(payment.amount − account.expected_net) WHERE payer_type = INSURANCE AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: Payment variance %
metrics.definition: Payment variance as a share of expected reimbursement on paid insurance accounts. Below −2% signals underpayment.
metrics.calculation: (SUM(payment) − SUM(expected)) / SUM(expected), insurance payments in period

metrics.name: Patient cash (self-pay)
metrics.definition: Payments from patients: point-of-service cash plus self-pay payments posted in the period. Prototype data has no patient payments on insured accounts; production includes them (payment source = patient).
metrics.calculation: SUM(transaction.amount) WHERE type = PAYMENT AND payment_source = PATIENT AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: Refunds
metrics.definition: Credit balances refunded to payers or patients in the period. Prototype: the refunds of the modeled insurance credit balances (see P6).
metrics.calculation: SUM(transaction.amount) WHERE type = REFUND AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: Insurance retractions
metrics.definition: Insurance payments taken back by the payer (recoupments and takebacks) posted in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(ABS(transaction.amount)) WHERE type = RETRACTION AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: Insurance retractions % of total cash
metrics.definition: Insurance retractions as a share of total cash posted in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(retractions) / SUM(cash posted), post date in period

metrics.name: Life-to-date yield by service month
metrics.definition: Payments to date on accounts discharged in the period, as a share of charges less contractual adjustments (expected net). Recent service months are still being paid, so their yield is low until they mature.
metrics.calculation: SUM(payments to data date) / (SUM(gross_charges) − SUM(contractual adjustments)) WHERE discharge_date IN period

metrics.name: Credit balances ($)
metrics.definition: Absolute value of accounts with a credit balance (overpayments awaiting refund) at period end. Prototype: modeled credits (see P6).
metrics.calculation: ABS(SUM(account.balance WHERE balance < 0)) at period end

metrics.name: Gross A/R
metrics.definition: Open debit balances (gross charges less payments) at the period-end snapshot.
metrics.calculation: SUM(ar_snapshot.gross_balance) WHERE snapshot_date = period end

metrics.name: Net A/R
metrics.definition: Open debit balances net of expected contractual allowances at the period-end snapshot.
metrics.calculation: SUM(ar_snapshot.net_balance) WHERE snapshot_date = period end

metrics.name: Net A/R days
metrics.definition: Net A/R at period end divided by average daily net revenue over the last 90 days. Ignores aging-bucket and account-status filters.
metrics.calculation: Net A/R (period end) / (SUM(expected_net, last 90 days) / 90)

metrics.name: Gross A/R days
metrics.definition: Month-end gross accounts receivable divided by trailing average daily gross patient service revenue.
metrics.calculation: Ending Gross AR ÷ (Trailing 90-Day Gross Patient Service Revenue ÷ 90)

metrics.name: A/R > 90 days
metrics.definition: Percentage of billed gross AR in the aged trial balance 91+ day aging buckets.
metrics.calculation: (Billed Gross AR in 91+ Buckets ÷ Total Billed Gross AR) × 100, period-end snapshot

metrics.name: A/R > 180 days
metrics.definition: Share of gross A/R more than 180 days from discharge.
metrics.calculation: Gross A/R aged 181+ days / gross A/R, period-end snapshot

metrics.name: Initial denial rate
metrics.definition: Claims with an initial denial (by denial date) as a share of claims submitted (by submit date) in the period.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(denial.claim_id, denial date) / COUNT(claim.claim_id, submit date)

metrics.name: Initial denial rate (claim dollars)
metrics.definition: Gross charges on claims initially denied at first adjudication as a percentage of gross charges on claims submitted. Prototype: denials by denial date over claims by submit date in the same period (a period-matched approximation of the submission cohort).
metrics.calculation: (Gross Charges on Initially Denied Claims ÷ Gross Charges on Claims Submitted) × 100

metrics.name: Initial denials ($)
metrics.definition: Gross charges on claims with an initial denial, by denial date.
metrics.calculation: SUM(denial.gross_amount) WHERE denial_date IN period

metrics.name: Denied claims
metrics.definition: Number of claims with an initial denial, by denial date.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(denial.claim_id) WHERE denial_date IN period

metrics.name: Denials as % of NPSR
metrics.definition: Expected net revenue on initially denied claims as a share of NPSR in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(denied account expected_net, denial date) / NPSR (discharge date)

metrics.name: Recoverable denials
metrics.definition: Share of denied dollars whose root cause is usually correctable or appealable.
metrics.calculation: SUM(denial.gross_amount WHERE root_cause.recoverable) / SUM(denial.gross_amount)

metrics.name: Appeal rate
metrics.definition: Share of denied claims (by denial date) that were formally appealed. Corrected-and-rebilled claims are not appeals.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(denial WHERE appealed) / COUNT(denial), by denial date

metrics.name: Appeal success rate
metrics.definition: Share of appeals resolved in the period that were overturned (paid).
metrics.calculation: COUNT(appeal WHERE resolved AND overturned) / COUNT(appeal WHERE resolved), by resolution date

metrics.name: Appeal upheld rate
metrics.definition: Share of resolved appeals where the payer upheld the denial (not overturned). For clinical appeals, filter the denial category to Medical necessity and Documentation.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(appeal WHERE resolved AND NOT overturned) / COUNT(appeal WHERE resolved), by resolution date

metrics.name: Appeals filed
metrics.definition: Denials appealed, by denial date (new appeal volume). For clinical appeals, filter the denial category.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(denial WHERE appealed), by denial date

metrics.name: Appeals resolved
metrics.definition: Appeals closed in the period (overturned or upheld).
metrics.calculation: COUNT(appeal WHERE resolved_date IN period)

metrics.name: Open appeals
metrics.definition: Denials marked for appeal and not yet resolved at period end (to be appealed, 1st and 2nd level).
metrics.calculation: COUNT(appeal WHERE filed AND NOT resolved) at period end

metrics.name: Denial write-offs
metrics.definition: Expected net revenue written off after a final denial, by write-off date.
metrics.calculation: SUM(transaction.amount) WHERE type = DENIAL_WRITE_OFF AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: Denial write-offs % of NPSR
metrics.definition: Denial write-offs as a share of NPSR in the same period.
metrics.calculation: Denial write-offs (post date) / NPSR (discharge date)

metrics.name: Front-end denial rate
metrics.definition: Denied dollars in eligibility, authorization and coordination-of-benefits categories as a share of gross charges submitted.
metrics.calculation: SUM(denial.gross_amount WHERE category IN (Eligibility, Authorization, COB)) / SUM(claim.gross_charges, submit date)

metrics.name: Clean claim rate
metrics.definition: Share of claims that pass all edits on first submission with no manual touch.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(claim WHERE first_pass_clean) / COUNT(claim), by submit date

metrics.name: Claims failing edits
metrics.definition: Claims that failed at least one claim edit on first submission and needed manual rework.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(claim WHERE NOT first_pass_clean), by submit date (split by edit category)

metrics.name: Claims submitted
metrics.definition: Claims sent to payers in the period.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(claim) WHERE submit_date IN period

metrics.name: Claims submitted ($)
metrics.definition: Gross charges on claims exported from the scrubber to payers in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(claim.gross_charges) WHERE submit_date IN period

metrics.name: First pass yield
metrics.definition: Share of adjudicated insurance claims that passed edits on the first submission, were not denied, and were paid. Prototype: a claim with no scrubber edit stands in for "no 277 rejection".
metrics.calculation: COUNT(claim WHERE no edit AND no 277 rejection AND no denial AND paid) / COUNT(claim adjudicated), by submit date

metrics.name: Billing lag (final bill to submit)
metrics.definition: Average days from final bill to claim submission, for claims submitted in the period.
metrics.calculation: AVG(submit_date − final_bill_date) WHERE submit_date IN period

metrics.name: DNFB
metrics.definition: Gross charges of discharged accounts not yet final billed, at the period-end snapshot.
metrics.calculation: SUM(dnfb_snapshot.gross_amount) WHERE stage = DNFB AND snapshot_date = period end

metrics.name: Days in DNFB
metrics.definition: Month-end gross charges for discharged accounts not yet final billed, expressed as days of average daily gross patient service revenue. Target: bill hold + 1.5 days.
metrics.calculation: Month-End Gross Dollars in DNFB ÷ (Trailing 90-Day Gross Patient Service Revenue ÷ 90)

metrics.name: Billed not submitted days
metrics.definition: Final-billed charges held by claim edits (not yet sent to the payer) at period end, as days of average daily gross charges.
metrics.calculation: DNSP $ (period end) / (SUM(gross_charges, last 90 days) / 90)

metrics.name: Billed not submitted ($)
metrics.definition: Gross charges on final-billed claims not yet exported to the payer (open scrubber edits) at period end.
metrics.calculation: SUM(dnfb_snapshot.gross_amount) WHERE stage = DNSP AND snapshot_date = period end

metrics.name: Billed claims not submitted
metrics.definition: Final-billed claims with no export to the payer (open scrubber edits) at period end.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(dnfb_snapshot.account) WHERE stage = DNSP AND snapshot_date = period end

metrics.name: Unbilled accounts (DNFB)
metrics.definition: Number of discharged accounts not final billed at the period-end snapshot.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(dnfb_snapshot.account) WHERE stage = DNFB AND snapshot_date = period end

metrics.name: DNFB aged 15+ days
metrics.definition: Share of DNFB dollars 15 or more days past discharge.
metrics.calculation: DNFB $ aged 15+ days / DNFB $, period-end snapshot

metrics.name: Charge lag
metrics.definition: Average days from date of service to charge posting, for accounts discharged in the period.
metrics.calculation: AVG(charge_post_date − service_date) WHERE discharge_date IN period

metrics.name: Late charges
metrics.definition: Charges posted after the final bill (requiring a late charge or corrected claim), as a share of gross charges.
metrics.calculation: SUM(charge.amount WHERE post_date > final_bill_date) / SUM(gross_charges), by discharge date

metrics.name: Missing charges recovered
metrics.definition: Charges found by charge reconciliation and added before billing, for accounts discharged in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(charge.amount WHERE source = RECONCILIATION) WHERE discharge_date IN period

metrics.name: Late charges ($)
metrics.definition: Charges posted after the final bill, for accounts discharged in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(charge.amount WHERE post_date > final_bill_date), by discharge date

metrics.name: Missed charge rate
metrics.definition: Charges found missing by charge reconciliation, as a share of gross charges.
metrics.calculation: SUM(charge.amount WHERE source = RECONCILIATION) / SUM(gross_charges), by discharge date

metrics.name: Charges posted
metrics.definition: Gross charges captured for accounts discharged in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(charge.amount) WHERE discharge_date IN period

metrics.name: Coding turnaround
metrics.definition: Average days from discharge to coding complete, for accounts coded in the period.
metrics.calculation: AVG(coded_date − discharge_date) WHERE coded_date IN period

metrics.name: Coding turnaround, inpatient
metrics.definition: Average days from discharge to coding complete for inpatient accounts coded in the period.
metrics.calculation: AVG(coded_date − discharge_date) WHERE patient_type = Inpatient AND coded_date IN period

metrics.name: Final coded accounts
metrics.definition: Accounts final coded in the period. Split by type with the patient type filter.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(account) WHERE coded_date IN period

metrics.name: Coding denial rate
metrics.definition: Denied dollars in the Coding category as a share of gross charges submitted.
metrics.calculation: SUM(denial.gross_amount WHERE category = Coding) / SUM(claim.gross_charges, submit date)

metrics.name: DNFB awaiting coding
metrics.definition: DNFB dollars on hold for coding at the period-end snapshot.
metrics.calculation: SUM(dnfb_snapshot.gross_amount) WHERE hold_reason = Awaiting coding

metrics.name: CDI query rate
metrics.definition: Share of inpatient discharges with at least one physician documentation query.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(inpatient account WHERE query_count > 0) / COUNT(inpatient account), by discharge date

metrics.name: Documentation-related denial rate
metrics.definition: Denied dollars in Documentation and Medical necessity categories as a share of gross charges submitted.
metrics.calculation: SUM(denial.gross_amount WHERE category IN (Documentation, Medical necessity)) / SUM(claim.gross_charges, submit date)

metrics.name: DNFB on physician query
metrics.definition: DNFB dollars on hold for a physician documentation query at the period-end snapshot.
metrics.calculation: SUM(dnfb_snapshot.gross_amount) WHERE hold_reason = Physician query

metrics.name: Eligibility verification rate
metrics.definition: Share of registrations with insurance eligibility verified electronically before or at service.
metrics.calculation: SUM(elig_verified) / SUM(elig_due), by service date

metrics.name: Authorization rate
metrics.definition: Share of services that require authorization with an authorization on file.
metrics.calculation: SUM(auth_obtained) / SUM(auth_required), by service date

metrics.name: Pre-service authorization rate
metrics.definition: Share of services that require authorization with the authorization obtained before the date of service.
metrics.calculation: SUM(auth_pre_service) / SUM(auth_required), by service date

metrics.name: Registration accuracy
metrics.definition: Share of submitted claims with no registration or demographic edit.
metrics.calculation: 1 − COUNT(claim WHERE edit_category = Registration) / COUNT(claim), by submit date

metrics.name: Registration edits
metrics.definition: Claims that failed a registration or demographic edit, by submit date. Stand-in for RQA edit volume until the registration quality (RQA) feed is loaded.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(claim WHERE edit_category = Registration), by submit date

metrics.name: Financial clearance rate
metrics.definition: Share of scheduled patients financially cleared (eligibility, benefits, estimate and authorization) before service.
metrics.calculation: SUM(fin_cleared) / SUM(fin_clear_due), by service date

metrics.name: Pre-registration rate
metrics.definition: Share of scheduled encounters pre-registered at least 24 hours before service.
metrics.calculation: SUM(pre_reg_done) / SUM(pre_reg_due), by service date

metrics.name: Order scheduling rate
metrics.definition: Share of received orders that are scheduled.
metrics.calculation: SUM(orders_scheduled) / SUM(orders_received), by service date

metrics.name: Scheduled volume
metrics.definition: Appointments scheduled from orders in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(orders_scheduled) WHERE date IN period

metrics.name: Orders received
metrics.definition: Orders received for scheduled services.
metrics.calculation: SUM(orders_received) WHERE date IN period

metrics.name: Order scheduling rate (final outcomes)
metrics.definition: Orders scheduled, as a share of orders with a final outcome (scheduled, cancelled or leaked to another provider). Orders still in process, duplicates and orders already scheduled are left out.
metrics.calculation: SUM(orders_scheduled) / SUM(orders_scheduled + orders_cancelled + orders_leakage), by date

metrics.name: Orders closed without scheduling
metrics.definition: Orders closed with no appointment: duplicate, already scheduled, leaked to another provider, or cancelled.
metrics.calculation: SUM(orders_duplicate + orders_already_scheduled + orders_leakage + orders_cancelled), by date

metrics.name: Open orders in process > 24 hours
metrics.definition: Share of open orders (to be scheduled) that have been in process for more than 24 hours, at period end.
metrics.calculation: open_orders_over_24h_eod / open_orders_eod on the last day of the period

metrics.name: Average scheduling lead time
metrics.definition: Average days from scheduling to the appointment, for appointments scheduled in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(schedule_days) / SUM(orders_scheduled), by date

metrics.name: % scheduled with lead time 3+ days
metrics.definition: Share of appointments scheduled 3 or more days before the date of service.
metrics.calculation: SUM(orders_scheduled3_plus) / SUM(orders_scheduled), by service date

metrics.name: Pre-registration finalization rate (72 hours)
metrics.definition: Share of scheduled encounters with pre-registration finalized at least 72 hours before service.
metrics.calculation: SUM(pre_reg_done72) / SUM(pre_reg_due), by service date

metrics.name: % of accounts scheduled < 72 hours before service
metrics.definition: Share of scheduled encounters booked less than 72 hours before the date of service (too late for the 72-hour pre-registration and financial clearance windows).
metrics.calculation: SUM(scheduled_under72h) / SUM(pre_reg_due), by service date

metrics.name: Financial clearance rate (72 hours)
metrics.definition: Share of scheduled patients financially cleared at least 72 hours before service.
metrics.calculation: SUM(fin_cleared72) / SUM(fin_clear_due), by service date

metrics.name: Open orders
metrics.definition: Orders not yet scheduled at the end of the last day of the period.
metrics.calculation: open_orders_eod on the last day of the period

metrics.name: Point-of-service collections
metrics.definition: Patient cash collected at or before the point of service.
metrics.calculation: SUM(transaction.amount) WHERE type = PAYMENT AND pos_flag AND post_date IN period

metrics.name: POS collection rate
metrics.definition: Point-of-service cash as a share of expected self-pay patient liability for encounters in the period.
metrics.calculation: SUM(POS cash) / SUM(expected_net WHERE financial_class = Self Pay), by service date

metrics.name: POS collection yield (vs estimate)
metrics.definition: Point-of-service cash as a share of the estimated patient liability, on accounts with an estimate. Prototype: estimates exist for self-pay accounts only.
metrics.calculation: SUM(POS cash WHERE estimate exists) / SUM(estimated patient liability), by service date

metrics.name: POS estimate accuracy
metrics.definition: Share of patient liability estimates within 10% of the final patient liability.
metrics.calculation: COUNT(estimate WHERE ABS(estimate − final liability) ≤ 10% × final liability) / COUNT(estimate), by service date

metrics.name: Missed POS opportunity (known residual)
metrics.definition: Known patient liability (estimate) not collected at the point of service, as a share of the estimate.
metrics.calculation: SUM(MAX(0, estimate − POS cash)) / SUM(estimate), by service date

metrics.name: Inbound calls (patient access)
metrics.definition: Inbound calls offered to the patient access line.
metrics.calculation: SUM(calls_offered) WHERE date IN period

metrics.name: Outbound calls (patient access)
metrics.definition: Outbound calls made by patient access staff.
metrics.calculation: SUM(calls_outbound) WHERE date IN period

metrics.name: Total call volume (all lines, inbound + outbound)
metrics.definition: Inbound and outbound calls on all in-scope lines: patient access (front end) and the business office customer service line (back end).
metrics.calculation: SUM(calls_offered + calls_outbound + cbo_calls_offered), by date

metrics.name: Call abandonment rate (all lines)
metrics.definition: Share of inbound calls on all in-scope lines (front end and back end) that end before an answer.
metrics.calculation: SUM(calls_abandoned) / SUM(calls_offered), all lines, by date

metrics.name: Call abandonment rate (business office line)
metrics.definition: Share of calls to the business office customer service line (back end) that end before an answer.
metrics.calculation: SUM(cbo_calls_abandoned) / SUM(cbo_calls_offered), by service date

metrics.name: Call abandonment rate
metrics.definition: Share of calls to the patient access line that end before an answer.
metrics.calculation: SUM(calls_abandoned) / SUM(calls_offered), by service date

metrics.name: Average speed to answer
metrics.definition: Average wait in seconds before an agent answers.
metrics.calculation: SUM(answer_wait_seconds) / COUNT(calls answered)

metrics.name: Uninsured accounts in scope (Medicaid E&E)
metrics.definition: Self-pay (uninsured) accounts in scope for Medicaid eligibility screening.
metrics.calculation: SUM(self_pay_accounts) WHERE date IN period

metrics.name: Medicaid screening rate
metrics.definition: Share of in-scope uninsured accounts screened for Medicaid eligibility, excluding accounts where all contact efforts are exhausted.
metrics.calculation: SUM(screened) / (SUM(self_pay_accounts) − SUM(efforts_exhausted)), by date

metrics.name: Medicaid eligible completion rate
metrics.definition: Share of patients likely eligible for Medicaid whose application was completed.
metrics.calculation: SUM(applications_completed) / SUM(medicaid_eligible), by service date

metrics.name: Coverage discovery rate
metrics.definition: Share of screened self-pay accounts where insurance or program coverage was found.
metrics.calculation: SUM(coverage_found) / SUM(screened), by service date
